Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Batangas, Cavite, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Laguna, Rizal and Nueva Ecija which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
